title: Shorter paths for the generation API
summary:
Shorter API paths and a new text model arrived alongside an image-editing fix and two community project listings.

A new gen.pollinations.ai gateway adds shorter paths for image and text generation, OpenAI-compatible requests, and the text model list. The API documentation now uses those paths and explains text-generation query parameters.

Added `nova-micro` for text conversations and tool use, with `amazon-nova-micro` and `nova` as aliases.

GPT Image img2img requests now use `gpt-image-1-mini` through the image edits endpoint instead of switching to `gpt-image-1`.

highlights.title: Shorter generation API paths
highlights.text: Call image and text generation through shorter `gen.pollinations.ai` paths, with `/models` as a shortcut to the text model list. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Amazon Nova Micro added
highlights.text: Use `nova-micro` for text conversations and tool calls. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova-micro).
